about:
# Fishing Helper

Fishing Helper is a World of Warcraft addon designed to simplify the fishing experience for **World of Warcraft: Forever**, Classic Era, and TBC Classic. It allows you to manage your fishing outfit and lures, provides a single button for equipping gear and casting the fishing spell, and includes quality-of-life features like automatic volume enhancement and auto-loot toggling.

## Features

- **One-Button Fishing**: A single macro button handles everything. Press it to automatically equip your configured fishing gear, apply a lure if needed, and cast the Fishing spell.
- **Outfit Management**: Configure your fishing gear (Fishing Pole, Hat, Gloves, and Boots) via an intuitive graphical interface. Simply drag and drop items into the slots or select them from the popup menu.
- **Lure Management**: Assign a specific lure (including classic lures and WoW Forever's *"Secret" Bait*) to auto-apply whenever your fishing pole lacks an active lure or enchant. The UI displays your current stock of that lure.
- **Quality-of-Life Sound**: Automatically increases the game's Master and SFX volume while you are actively channeling the Fishing spell, making it easier to hear the bobber splash. The volume is restored to its original level when you stop casting.
- **Auto-Loot**: Automatically enables the game's Auto Loot feature when your fishing gear is equipped.
- **Restore Previous State**: A convenient "Stop Fishing" button will unequip your fishing outfit, restore your previously equipped gear, and revert your Auto Loot setting.
- **Minimap Keybindings Menu & Addon Compartment**: Right-click the minimap button to open a settings panel and configure your Cast Fishing and Stop Fishing keybinds directly. Supports keyboard keys, modifiers, mouse buttons (like Mouse Button 4/5), and the mouse scroll wheel. Also integrates directly into the modern Addon Compartment dropdown.
- **World Map Fishing Level Display**: Displays the required Fishing skill to never miss catching a fish (0% getaway chance) directly at the top of the in-game map, right next to the area name drop-down menu. Includes a rich tooltip showing minimum cast skill, your character's current skill, catch status, and zone notes.

## Slash Commands

- `/fh` - Toggles the Fishing Helper configuration frame.

## Usage

1. Type `/fh` in chat to open the Fishing Helper frame (or click the minimap icon / Addon Compartment entry).
2. Drag and drop your fishing pole, fishing hat, gloves, boots, and preferred lure into the corresponding slots on the frame. To clear a slot, right-click it.
3. Drag the main action button from the top-left of the frame onto your standard action bar, or set a keybind for it. The dragged macro will dynamically update its icon and tooltip to show exactly what action it will perform next!
4. Click your action bar button (or press your keybind) to start fishing!
    - **First click**: Equips your configured fishing gear.
    - **Second click**: Applies the configured lure to your fishing pole (if the pole does not currently have a lure or enchant).
    - **Subsequent clicks**: Casts the Fishing spell.
5. When you are finished fishing, open the configuration frame (`/fh`) and click **Stop Fishing**. This will restore the gear you were wearing before you started fishing and revert your auto-loot preference.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release.
2. Extract the `FishingHelper` folder into your World of Warcraft AddOns directory (e.g. `World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns\FishingHelper`).
3. Ensure the addon is enabled in the AddOn selection screen when logging in.

# Fishing Helper

## [v1.6.1](https://github.com/malkamius/FishingHelper/tree/v1.6.1) (2026-11-24)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/malkamius/FishingHelper/commits/v1.6.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/malkamius/FishingHelper/releases)

- chore(release): v1.6.1  
- ci: add GitHub/CurseForge release workflow  
- feat(keybindings): prefix binding display names with addon name  
- feat(keybindings): group under AddOns category, add keybind buttons and target forever client  
- feat(minimap): upgrade minimap icon to gold-bordered fish  
    Replace the previous square logo with a clean, high-visibility  
    fish icon and redesign the minimap button to maximize visible artwork.  
    - Add icon\_fish.png featuring a gold-bordered circular fish icon  
      with transparent corners and full mouth detail.  
    - Strip bulky MiniMap-TrackingBorder overlay and background from both  
      LibDBIcon and standalone buttons to prevent icon clipping.  
    - Expand icon texture to fill the full 30x30 button area (matching  
      Farmin Forever's sleek button style).  
    - Update TOC IconTexture metadata to use the new fish icon.  
    - Bump addon version to 1.6.0.  
- fix(package): support wowAddonPaths array from wow\_paths.json  
- fix(gear): track normal equipment in saved variables  
    Continuously track the player's normal equipment before swapping into  
    fishing gear so gear restoration persists across logouts, disconnects,  
    and UI reloads.  
    - Add TrackNormalGear to proactively record normal outfit and offhand  
      gear whenever not wearing fishing equipment.  
    - Prevent PLAYER\_EQUIPMENT\_CHANGED from clearing savedGear upon login  
      or zone transition while equipped with fishing gear.  
    - Ensure GetItemNameOrID returns item: fallback instead of raw  
      formatted hyperlinks (|c...) that fail in macros when items are uncached.  
    - Register GET\_ITEM\_INFO\_RECEIVED to update macros once item cache loads.  
    - Ensure the Stop Fishing macro is armed on login/reconnect if already  
      wearing fishing gear.  
    - Synchronize panel and popup item assignment with TrackNormalGear.  
    - Update deploy.ps1 to support multi-target deployment paths.  
    - Bump addon version to 1.5.1.  
- feat: add World of Warcraft: Forever support and World Map fishing indicator  
    Add compatibility for World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001 / Camelot)  
    alongside Classic Era and TBC Classic. Introduce a World Map Fishing  
    Skill indicator displaying zone never-miss requirements, Addon Compartment  
    integration, and support for modern item and spell APIs.  
    - Add FishingHelper\_Map.lua with comprehensive zone fishing skill data,  
      never-miss thresholds, and rich map tooltips.  
    - Add FishingHelper\_Camelot.toc and interface 16001 support.  
    - Implement Addon Compartment menu callbacks and LibDataBroker support.  
    - Support modern C\_Spell, C\_Item, and C\_PaperDollInfo temporary enchant APIs.  
    - Add support for WoW Forever's "Secret" Bait and custom zones.  
    - Update logo texture and README documentation.  
- chore: update interface version to 11508 and 20505 for classic era and tbc support  
- chore: update interface version to 11508 for classic era  
- feat(ui): add right-click keybind settings window  
    - Implement settings frame for direct Cast and Stop Fishing keybinds.  
    - Register minimap button Right-Click to toggle the settings frame.  
    - Add mouse click (AnyUp) and mouse wheel support to keybind rows.  
    - Add screen blocker button to cancel binding mode when clicking outside.  
    - Disable keyboard capture and set propagation on settings window by default.  
    - Automatically restore auto-loot when the fishing pole is unequipped.  
- perf(core): improve lure application responsiveness and fix flicker  
    - Reduce OnUpdate timer from 1.0s to 0.2s for faster macro updates.  
    - Implement spellcast tracking (UNIT\_SPELLCAST\_*) for lure application.  
    - Add a 2-second success buffer to prevent the macro from flickering  
      back to "Apply Lure" while waiting for the weapon enchant to be  
      detected by the client.  
    - Force macro update to "Fishing" immediately when lure cast starts.  
- chore: bump version to 1.1.0  
- feat: forget saved gear if manually changed during fishing  
- chore: Bump version to 1.0.9.  
- refactor: Update item API calls to C\_Item, refine volume restoration logic during fishing, and add diagnostic comments.  
- fix: event handling for channeling was incorrect, fixes volume adjustment now  
- fix: Prevent unnecessary macro rewrites by checking existing content, fixing an issue where you couldn't edit macros with the mod loaded  
- feat: refactor UI to multiple files  
- feat: Add an item selection popup for gear and lure slots, migrate item API calls to C\_Item, and update .toc metadata.  
- chore: update addon version to 1.0.3  
- feat: Add a minimap button to toggle the UI and keybindings for casting/stopping fishing.  
- chore: bump version to 1.0.2  
- fix: Change main button click registration from AnyUp to AnyDown.  
- feat: Implement draggable dynamic macro for the main button and update its UI template.  
- Update README.md for dynamic macro behavior  
- feat: add initial README.md detailing the Fishing Helper addon's features, usage, and installation.  
- feat: Implement the Fishing Helper addon, providing a UI for gear management and core fishing automation logic.
